limits: The minor grapes together: at most 15%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.
land: Faces the morning sun. Early light dries the dew, which cuts disease, and the grapes are spared the hottest afternoon sun.

blurb.text: A Grand Cru in Gevrey-Chambertin, in the Côte de Nuits, making red wine from Pinot Noir. Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are also allowed.
